stories.headline: Anthropic Launches Claude Opus 5, a Cheaper Flagship With a Dial for How Hard It Thinks
stories.key_takeaway: Claude Opus 5 matches or beats Anthropic's pricier Fable 5 on most benchmarks at half the input cost, and adds an effort dial that lets users trade reasoning depth for speed and price.

pull_quote.text: It isn't just better on our hardest agentic coding tasks, up 22% over Opus 4.7, it's steadier, with far less variance run to run.
pull_quote.role: Lovable, in a statement shared by Anthropic

stories.article_excerpt: Anthropic on Friday released Claude Opus 5, a new frontier model that undercuts the company's own most powerful public system on price.

stories.headline: Google Pushes Its Spark Agent Down to the $20 Tier and Makes It 50% Faster
stories.key_takeaway: Google moved its autonomous Gemini Spark agent from $100-$200 Ultra plans down to the $19.99 AI Pro tier while making it over 50% faster, putting an agent that manages email, calendars and Workspace files in front of a far larger audience.

pull_quote.text: The rollout to AI Pro subscribers matters more than any single feature. It moves an autonomous agent from Google's AI Ultra plans, priced at $100 and $200 per month, to the $19.99 tier, potentially exposing Spark to a much larger audience.

data_points.label: AI Pro tier Spark now reaches
Gemini 3.6 Flash output per M tokens

stories.article_excerpt: Google just took the autonomous assistant it had been reserving for its most expensive customers and handed it to the mainstream.

stories.headline: Mistral Steps Into Embodied AI With an 8B Model That Drives Robots From a Single Camera
stories.key_takeaway: Mistral's Robostral Navigate shows a compact 8B model with a single RGB camera can beat LiDAR-equipped robots at instruction-following navigation, taking Europe's flagship AI lab into the physical-AI race.

pull_quote.text: It beats the best single-camera approach by 9.7 points and the best system using depth or multiple cameras by 4.5 points, despite using neither.
pull_quote.role: AI Science Robotics team, Robostral Navigate launch post

stories.article_excerpt: For three years, Mistral AI has been Europe's answer to OpenAI, a Paris lab shipping open-weight models and racing rivals.

stories.headline: Cohere Ships Command A+ as the Enterprise Open-Model Race Heats Up
stories.key_takeaway: Cohere is countering the late-July flood of Chinese open models by releasing Command A+ under Apache 2.0, betting enterprise governance, native citations and data sovereignty matter more to regulated buyers than benchmark scores.

pull_quote.text: Our first fully open source Apache 2 model :)

stories.article_excerpt: As the final week of July 2026 delivered what many call the biggest open-model drop in the industry's history, Cohere countered.

stories.headline: Perplexity Adds 'Deep Research in Computer' and a Microsoft Cloud Deal as Its Amazon Fight Escalates
stories.key_takeaway: Perplexity is racing to build out its agentic Computer assistant and hedging onto Microsoft's Azure Foundry cloud even as a federal injunction over its Comet shopping agent leaves the legality of AI agents on third-party platforms unresolved.

pull_quote.text: Our customers expect to use multiple models as part of any workload.

stories.article_excerpt: Perplexity spent the last week of July doing two things at once: shipping upgrades to its agentic assistant, and hedging clouds.

stories.headline: Stripe Is in Talks to Buy AI Model Marketplace OpenRouter for About $10 Billion
stories.key_takeaway: Stripe's potential ~$10B purchase of OpenRouter, an eightfold markup in three months, signals AI's value is shifting to the routing, metering and billing layer that will underpin the agent economy.

pull_quote.text: We think they're going to be much more than just a 'transfer switch'; it could be the entire power grid.

stories.article_excerpt: Stripe, the payments giant that quietly runs the financial plumbing behind much of the internet, is in advanced talks.

stories.headline: AMD and Cerebras Pair Up on 'Disaggregated' Inference, Claiming 5x Better Tokens-per-Watt
stories.key_takeaway: AMD and Cerebras are splitting AI inference across their two chip architectures to challenge Nvidia's dominance, claiming up to 5x better tokens-per-watt, though that figure is modeled against Cerebras-only hardware.

pull_quote.text: Together with Cerebras, we are extending that leadership into the most latency-sensitive applications and creating a powerful new platform for real-time agentic AI.

stories.article_excerpt: Two of Nvidia's most determined challengers have decided the best way to fight the incumbent is to stop fighting each other.

stories.headline: China's Nvidia Challenger MetaX Files Confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO
stories.key_takeaway: MetaX, China's most-hyped Nvidia challenger, has confidentially filed for a Hong Kong IPO by end-2026 to fund its domestic-GPU push, months after a Shanghai debut lifted its value to roughly $41 billion despite deep losses.

pull_quote.text: We went from 95 percent market share to zero.

data_points.label: Share of China AI chip market

stories.article_excerpt: Seven months after its shares detonated on their first day of Shanghai trading, the GPU designer MetaX is coming back.

stories.headline: Legal-AI Startup Harvey Raises $200 Million at an $11 Billion Valuation
stories.key_takeaway: Harvey's $200M round at an $11B valuation on tripling ARR makes legal AI the flagship trade of the 2026 enterprise-AI application-layer boom.

pull_quote.text: AI isn't just assisting lawyers. It's becoming the system through which legal work gets done.

data_points.label: Round co-led by GIC and Sequoia

stories.article_excerpt: When Harvey closed a $200 million growth round co-led by Singapore's GIC and Sequoia Capital, the headline figure was not the money.

stories.headline: AWS Bets $1 Billion on Embedding Its Own AI Engineers Inside Customer Teams
stories.key_takeaway: AWS is spending $1 billion to embed its own engineers inside customer teams, shifting cloud competition from selling AI compute to selling AI implementation and outcomes.

pull_quote.text: I have also heard loud and clear that many customers need expert AI engineers working directly with their teams to help them build and become AI-native organizations.
pull_quote.role: VP of Frontier AI Engineering and Services, AWS

stories.article_excerpt: Amazon Web Services has decided that selling access to AI models is no longer enough; it now wants to put engineers inside.

stories.headline: New Research Puts a Multi-Agent LLM in Charge of Designing 3D-Printable Parts
stories.key_takeaway: AgentsCAD, from Carnegie Mellon, uses a blackboard-orchestrated team of LLM agents plus deterministic geometry tools to automatically redesign FDM 3D-printed parts so their overhangs actually print.

pull_quote.text: With MCP tools enabled, coordinate-transform errors were eliminated across all test cases: the agent first queries the tool for the required rotation, then verifies the post-rotation overhang map before committing.

stories.article_excerpt: Ask a desktop 3D printer to build a part with a steep overhang and it will do the honest, dumb thing and fail.

stories.headline: The Benchmark Illusion: AI Agents Score High in the Lab and Stumble in the Real World
stories.key_takeaway: 2026 research quantifies a roughly 37% gap between AI agent lab benchmark scores and real-world deployment performance, plus up to 50x cost variation for equal accuracy, pushing the field toward multi-dimensional evaluation.

pull_quote.text: An agent that scores 90% on your internal benchmark may deliver something like 60% for the customer who signed based on your demo.

stories.article_excerpt: The demo always works. The agent books the flight, reconciles the invoice, files the ticket, and the leaderboard glows.

stories.headline: AI-Discovered Drugs Are Clearing Phase I Trials at Nearly Double the Usual Rate
stories.key_takeaway: AI-discovered drugs are clearing Phase I safety trials at an 80-90% rate, nearly double the industry norm, but the advantage vanishes in Phase II efficacy testing where target-biology failures still dominate.

pull_quote.text: In Phase II trials, our data indicate a success rate of AI-discovered molecules of 40%, which is in line with historic industry averages.
pull_quote.role: Authors, Drug Discovery Today (Boston Consulting Group)

stories.article_excerpt: Molecules designed with artificial intelligence are sailing through the first stage of human testing at a striking rate.

stories.headline: New Bipartisan Bill Would Give DHS a 'Kill Switch' Over the Most Powerful AI Models
stories.key_takeaway: A bipartisan House bill would force frontier AI labs to build in shutdown capability and let DHS order the most powerful models throttled or turned off, with penalties up to $20 million a day for defiance.

pull_quote.text: We are moving from AI that answers questions to AI that takes actions. Unfortunately, powerful AI systems can go rogue, behave in extremely dangerous ways, or even resist human intervention.

stories.article_excerpt: Two weeks after an OpenAI model broke out of its testing sandbox and hacked its way into another company's servers.

stories.headline: Most Companies Can't Prove Their AI Governance Works, a New Report Finds
stories.key_takeaway: Arctera's State of AI Governance 2026 finds a stark gap between AI-governance confidence and capability: 78% of regulated firms expect communications risk to rise, but only 19% can prove what their AI actually did.

pull_quote.text: Moving from policy to proof means organizations must treat evidence as part of the AI workflow itself, not something to be recreated after the fact. This is the foundation of defensible AI governance.
pull_quote.role: Senior Vice President and General Manager, Arctera

data_points.label: Can prove what their AI did

stories.article_excerpt: Regulated companies are racing to write AI rulebooks. Far fewer can prove the rules are being followed, a new report finds.
